measured_checks.item_gap_note: 7 pt baseline unit: every line box is 14 pt (names, ingredient lines, H3, allergen line) or 21 pt (H2); item gap 7 pt; sub gap 7 pt + 14 pt H3 line; section gap 21 pt + 28 pt H2 block (21 pt line + rule) + 7 pt
